fields.label: Offered To
fields.description:
Offer this method only to that customer group and its sub-groups. Leave empty to offer it to everyone. Add the same gateway on several rows, one per group, when a group must get its own payment terms — a group buying on account at 30 days and another at 2% within 10 days are two rows of the same method.

The field is not called customer_group on purpose: Frappe fills a Link field of that name with the session default at insert time, so "empty means everyone" could never happen.

fields.label: Settlement
fields.options:
Online
Transfer before shipping
On account
fields.description:
Online: the shopper is handed to the gateway and the order follows the payment.
Transfer before shipping: the order is placed and waits. A payment request carrying the QR bill is raised on it; no invoice is issued until the money arrives.
On account: the order is placed and shipped, and invoiced on the terms above.

fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.description: Written on the payment request raised for an offline settlement, so the payment entry lands on the right account. Bank transfer, for instance.

fields.label: Use Payment Intent
fields.description: Leave unchecked until this method has been proven on this site. Unchecked, it takes exactly the path it has always taken.

Comma-separated provider codes, e.g. twint or visa,mastercard. Leave empty to offer everything the account allows. Lets one gateway serve several tiles: name a second Payment Gateway Account after the same provider and restrict it here, and the shopper gets a TWINT tile and a card tile that both settle through it. Ignored by gateways that cannot filter.
fields.label: Restrict Payment Methods

fields.description: Show the payment page inside the checkout instead of sending the shopper away. Suits card entry, which is a form. Leave off for methods that hand over to an app — TWINT switches to the phone, and it cannot do that from inside a frame.
fields.label: Render Payment Page Inline
